newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 17.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 17.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones rose 38.49 points to 6,765.37. PLDT's ADR rose $0 3/8 to $58 3/4.
* On Thursday, the peso softened to 26.299 to a U.S. dollar from 26.298.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,290.19, up 31.67.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average rate was steady at 10.53125 pct.
* Prices of all petroleum products will go up by an average of 26 centavos per liter effective today. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)

* The National Power Corp will ask the Energy Regulatory Board (ERB) to approve a three to 13 centavos per kilowatt-hour (kwh) reduction in basic power rates to reflect more efficient operations of its oil-based thermal power plants. (INQUIRER/MANILA BULLETIN)
* The Central Bank has approved a 100 percent increase in over-the-counter dollar transactions to $50,000 from the existing $25,000 ceiling. (ALL NEWSPAPERS)
* The Employers Confederation of the Philippines (Ecop) says its against a wage hike as this will result in "macroeconomic disequilibrium characterised by runaway inflation." (BUSINESSWORLD)
* Four local and foreign companies have tendered offers for partnerships or mergers to packaging firm Steniel Manufacturing Corp. (BUSINESSWORLD)
